name: Opus Woodworking
old_description: We take pride in our meticulous attention to detail, using only the finest materials and techniques to ensure every piece is crafted to perfection. From concept to completion, we work closely with you to create meaningful, lasting additions to your home or business.
about:
Opus Woodworking was established in 2008 in Columbus, Ohio, as a design-driven atelier focused on fine woodworking. The company operates as a custom woodworking business crafting artisanal, handcrafted wood products for residential and commercial spaces.

The shop produces bespoke furniture, architectural wood installations, custom cabinetry, and shelving systems including floating shelves, full-wall storage, partitions, and feature walls. Pieces are handcrafted from premium hardwoods using time-honored joinery techniques and precise construction methods. The workshop also fabricates mantels, stair railings, built-in bookshelves, and fireplace surrounds.

Opus serves discerning homeowners, architects, interior designers, and builders across residential and commercial projects. Clients have included homeowners such as Sarah Karakaian and Terri Dalenta, as well as design firms like Wannemacher Interiors and JWAA Interiors, who commission mantels, built-in bookshelves, and historically appropriate interior finishes.

The company states it differentiates itself through an uncompromising commitment to mastery over mass production, emphasizing authenticity, craftsmanship, and legacy. Its declared principles include not rushing projects, not compromising materials, and not overlooking details, with a collaborative process from consultation through installation.
